name: agentguard
description: Put agentguard, an MCP policy proxy, in front of this project's MCP servers: a dry-run first, then spend caps, approvals for destructive tools, a kill switch and a hash-chained audit log. And check which rules in CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md your coding agents broke, from your own sessions. Runs npx @agentwares/agentguard on your machine; no account, no LLM calls.
